finished_at.description: When it succeeded or failed; absent while it runs.

kind.description: What the work is: report_export prepares an accountant export (requestReportExport); checks_run runs every check (runChecks); migration_validation validates an uploaded workbook (uploadMigrationWorkbook).

resource.description: The path of what the work makes or changes: read it for the outcome, such as the export's file or the checks' last run.

status.description: running: waiting or under way, and retried after a failure; succeeded: done, so read the resource; failed: it gave up after its attempts, so ask again.
